profile_text.body:
Hut 8 Corp. is a Miami, Florida company that describes itself as owning, operating, and scaling purpose-built businesses that acquire, deploy, and monetize specialized hardware for next-generation, energy-intensive technologies. Through that portfolio, the company says it provides direct exposure to markets created by transformative technologies such as AI and Bitcoin mining. It is a public company traded under the ticker HUT.

On its site, Hut 8 states that it has fully commercialized a 1 GW Beacon Point AI data center campus with a second 352 MW IT lease, which it says brings campus-level base-term contract value to $19.6 billion.

The company's record shows no tracked AI products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. Its headquarters are listed in Florida, and it has a CIK filing identifier, 0001964789.
